hook.text: In 2013, the first lab-grown burger cost $330,000. By 2023, it was served at restaurants.

buildup.text: Cultured meat grows animal cells without the animal. No slaughter, less land, fewer emissions.

discovery.text: Singapore became the first country to approve lab-grown chicken for sale in 2020.

twist.text: Cattle ranchers and religious authorities both oppose it—one fears lost income, the other questions its purity.

climax.text: If meat no longer requires killing, it forces every culture to rethink what eating means.

punchline.text: Real meat without the animal changes everything.

quiz.question: Which country first approved lab-grown meat for commercial sale?
